# [STORY] As a client app, I want a media service for user-uploaded assets backed by MinIO and MongoDB, so that the platform can store binary media beyond what TMDB posters cover

## User Story
**As a** client app
**I want** a media service for user-uploaded assets backed by MinIO and MongoDB
**So that** the platform can store binary media beyond what TMDB posters cover

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a user uploads media, when the media service handles it, then it's stored in MinIO with metadata in MongoDB (Task #37: `MediaServiceTest.givenMultipartUpload_whenUploadMedia_thenSavesToStorageAndRepository`, `MediaControllerTest.whenUploadEndpointInvoked_thenReturns201Created`)
